title: 2017 LTCF Email Updates | NHSN | CDC
content: 2017 LTCF Email Updates Print Minus Related Pages December 13, 2017 Coming Soon: Updates to the NHSN Training Website Dear NHSN Users, The NHSN team would like to thank you again for the valuable feedback provided on the 2016 NHSN Education and Training Needs Assessment survey! NHSN user responses on the survey indicated a need for increased navigability and more streamlined access to training activities and materials. This feedback has been incorporated into updates on the NHSN Training website . Attached to this email is a summary of the most notable changes to the NHSN Training website. Keep an eye out for the updated website to go live in early 2018! Please direct any questions to NHSNTrain@cdc.gov . Thank you! The NHSN Team Training Newsletters / Members Meeting Updates E-mail Updates Health Department HAI/AR Programs Last Reviewed: March 30, 2023 Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention , National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) , Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP)
